description: This PHP source file defines the class OA_Admin_UI_AccountSwitch, which provides helper methods for user account switching in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for assigning account models to templates, managing recently used accounts, and filtering accounts by name and limit.

classes.name: OA_Admin_UI_AccountSwitch
classes.description: Helper class for user account switching, managing recent accounts, and filtering account lists.

methods.name: assignModel
methods.description: Assigns account data to a template, including recent, admin, and other accounts, with filtering and limits.

methods.name: addToRecentlyUsedAccounts
methods.description: Adds an account ID to the session's recently used accounts list.

methods.name: filterByNameAndLimit
methods.description: Filters a list of accounts by name query and limits the number of results.
